messages:
Carla R: Quick thread to decide ENI-binding onboarding and backoff behavior. We sketched ENI-opt-in earlier; need concrete attach strategy and failure backstop.
Tom L: AWS attach limits are real. If we attach on-demand per-connection we'll hit attach/detach QPS and throttle. Proposal: maintain a warm-ENI pool per-region per-tenant-tier and reuse ENIs for sessions to avoid churn.
Priya N: Warm-pool sounds good. Implementation options:
  - per-tenant warm pool (1-3 ENIs) for enterprise tenants
  - shared warm pool + ephemeral mapping for mid-tier
  Pool size driven by recent peak concurrency; autoscale with hysteresis.
Evan P: Backoff strategy: if attach throttle occurs, broker should mark tenant as "eni-degraded" and route to micro-gateway header-preserve mode automatically for X minutes, escalate to SRE if >Y failures.
Alice M: UX: Console needs to show binding state (ENI-bound | ENI-warming | MGW-fallback), pool size, and last attach error. Also allow SRE to force-fallback per-tenant.
sre-bot: Draft alert rules suggested: eni.attach.throttle_count > 5 in 5m, eni.pool.low_capacity, broker.binding.error_rate > 0.5%.
Carla R: Observability: emit trace with tenant_id, binding_id, attach_latency, and attach_result. Keep recent attach logs for 24h.
Tom L: Edge cases: account-level ENI quotas vary. We need per-customer quota checks at onboard time and a graceful decline path (do not attempt ENI for tenants over quota; show upgrade path).
Priya N: Migration plan:
  1) simulate attach QPS with 200 synthetic tenants (PoC)
  2) run warm-pool autoscaler in canary region (non-prod tenants)
  3) enable ENI-opt-in for a small set of enterprise customers
  4) monitor attach throttles and route-table growth for 2 weeks
Evan P: Cost model: ENI idle cost, endpoint service fees, and extra route capacity. I'll model monthly delta and add to billing gating proposal.
Carla R: Owners: Priya -> implement warm-pool PoC, Tom -> attach/throttle simulation, Evan -> cost model, Alice -> UI states, SRE -> alerts + synthetic tests. Target PoC results in 10 days.
Tom L: +1. If PoC shows unacceptable attach throttles we default to MGW header-preserve as main path.
Carla R: thanks. I'll capture this as the ENI onboarding appendix in the RFC follow-up. Closing actions: Priya will post PoC link in this thread.
